# truenas_scrub_run (Action)

Starts a scrub on a pool (pool.scrub, action START).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Kick off a pool scrub (Terraform 1.14+).
action "truenas_scrub_run" "example" {
  config {
    pool_id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pool_id` (Number) Pool id to scrub (truenas_pool.<name>.id).
